notes: All 80 lessons (u05 50, u06 30) now have LV, EV, at least five questions at levels 1-3 linked to objectives, an SA extended answer, and at least six content blocks.

Levels follow the DfE GCSE/A level coverage mappings: mapped to both specs = 'GCSE and A level'; Further Maths topics (conics, hyperbolic functions) = 'A level'; beyond A level judged from content (Year 2/3; Symplectic Geometry = Postgraduate).
Every new numeric answer and worked example was recomputed (Python); NUM answers use ASCII minus.

Whole files grew by about 52% (u05) and 46% (u06) in bytes, above the ~30% guideline. Nearly all of the growth is assessment lines (SA model answers and marking points, plus the new questions); teaching prose grew by one block per thin lesson. Thin lessons gained one block each.
No SRC lines were added or changed.
